task_title: Fix six critical review defects: order/testament, canonical identities, source-ID aliases, profile/context curation, test false-positive, open-question DB state
result: PASS — all six defects are fixed and verified: canon order and testament are authoritative, collective Israel identity is redirected, Paul/Peter are preferred names with real aliases, source-ID aliases are gone, profiles carry source content, the receipt assertion is null-safe, and open-question state is preserved in the database.

1_wrong_order_testament.cause: Books were enumerated by alphabetical filename, then the first 39 alphabetically were called OT (Acts OT, Nehemiah NT, wrong order_index and unit ordinals).
1_wrong_order_testament.fix: New tools/canon_order.py parses the committed books.ts skeleton for order + testament. The queue and tools/import-english-canon.py both use it. The importer repairs earlier data (works upsert, membership delete+reinsert, unit ordinal shift+upsert, scope kind upsert) under IMPORT_REVISION=3, with the digest covering canon order.
1_wrong_order_testament.proof: Acts=NT, Neh=OT, Gen=1, Matt=40, Rev=66 in canon_work_memberships; test 11 section 6b asserts exactly this.

2_identity_errors.collective_israel: 686 of 1,003 p-jacob-1 refs whose BSB surface reads 'people/children/house of Israel', 'all Israel', 'Israelites' (incl. Ezra 6:16) were moved to entity:israelites before registry build. Non-person territory usages ('land/kingdom of Israel') are dropped, not guessed. Ezra 6:16 now attests entity:israelites; the wrong Jacob mention no longer exists.
2_identity_errors.paul_peter: p-saul-2 preferred name is Paul (alias Saul), p-simon-1 is Peter (aliases Simon, Cephas, Simon Peter, Simeon, Simon Barjona). Plus all proper-name person labels become aliases.
2_identity_errors.scope: persons used as narrative subjects keep person identity; only collective/territory surfaces were redirected or dropped.

3_source_id_aliases.cause: OpenBible internal identification ids (a15257a, m66c5b8, ...) were stored as registry aliases and imported as searchable English entity_names; 573 ids were shared across unrelated places.
3_source_id_aliases.fix: Non-name aliases (all-lowercase 4-10 char source ids) are dropped at the queue boundary. Registry source-ID aliases: 3,042 -> 0.
3_source_id_aliases.proof: validate_canon identity report; entity_names contain real names only.

4_profiles_contexts.profiles: Generic 'named in Scripture' profiles 4,253 -> 1,024: 2,974 persons now carry their BibleData identifying attribute (+ tribe), 286 places carry their OpenBible description, 31 locked-Neh2 profiles stay rich. Remaining generic rows are places with no source description — honest fallback.
4_profiles_contexts.chapter_before: All 1,189 chapter 'before' fields are filled mechanically ('Opening chapter of X' / 'Follows X n-1') and their blocking questions retired; locale coverage was recomputed so it no longer blocks on them.
4_profiles_contexts.not_attempted: objects/roles/practices/terms/themes/chronology/historical context and chapter when/stakes stay open questions — unsupported by approved inputs and not invented.

5_test_false_positive.cause: The English receipt wrote review_state but test 11 read review_status, so a null comparison never failed.
5_test_false_positive.fix: The receipt now uses review_status (same convention as import-neh2), and every receipt/coverage assertion in test 11 is null-safe (IS DISTINCT FROM / explicit IS NULL checks).

6_open_question_state.cause: Skipped null-text sections were invisible in the DB.
6_open_question_state.fix: Migration 20260916000015 adds context_sections.curation_state (curated|open_question|not_applicable) + open_question_key with a consistency check. The importer emits every field: curated rows keep text, open-question rows carry '' + the blocking key. 14,585 open_question sections preserved; curated rows carry null keys. Test 11 asserts both.

commands_executed.output: 335/335 jobs valid; 66 books merged; registry 4,295; Paul/Peter renamed; collective redirect 686 moved.

1,024 place profiles remain 'named in Scripture' span text (no source description exists).
